Some models approximate this from transcripts and timestamps, but Google's agentic video understanding claims to be up to 88% more token efficient and about 7% more accurate, with the biggest gains on long files.

items.title: Despite the cost narrative, buyers moved to pricier models
items.summary: Models: Frontier models' share of spend went from 35% to 63%, while mid-tier, small and older models all lost share. This happened even as labs cut small-model prices by more than 80%. Today's favorites, Claude Opus 5.5 ($4/$20 per million tokens) and GPT-6 Astro ($10/$60), cost more than last year's leaders.

items.summary: ◆ The Take: Agentic coding never meant non-coders replacing developers, and agentic video won't mean amateurs matching professional editors and directors.
